stagecoach.jei.info.break: By default only the owner (or an operator) can take a stagecoach down, and explosions can't.
stagecoach.jei.info.discover: Right-click someone else's stagecoach to discover it. Right-click one you know to open the list of destinations.
stagecoach.jei.info.place: It needs a clear space 3 wide, 3 tall and 6 long, and faces away from you. Hold one and aim at the ground to see where it would go: green fits, red doesn't. You name it when you place it.
stagecoach.jei.info.travel: A journey costs XP levels or items, as the server decides (more the further you go, up to a limit), and takes time: you ride the road, safe, until you arrive. Cancel any time to get your fare back. You can't set off right after being hit.
stagecoach.jei.info.what: A stagecoach is a stop on the road network. Travel between any two stops you know (by default, only within one dimension).
